quality.sectionTitle: Controlled Quality from Drawing Review to Final Inspection
paragraphs: Every project begins with a review of the drawing, material, dimensions, surface finish and application requirements.
For suitable sheet metal components, manufacturing precision of up to **±0.2 mm** may be achieved, depending on product design, material, thickness and production process.
Inspection requirements can include dimensional checks, welding quality, surface finishing, assembly and final appearance.

sections.title: From Flat Sheet to Finished Electrical Enclosure
sections.description:
For this custom electrical box project, the production process included sheet cutting, punching or laser opening, bending, welding, grinding, powder coating, silk-screen printing and final assembly.

By coordinating each manufacturing stage around the confirmed drawing, the enclosure was produced according to the required dimensions, appearance and functional requirements.

sections.description: This existing project shows sheet metal enclosures for self-service ordering kiosks. The photographs illustrate the outer metal housing and panel openings. For a similar project, provide your own equipment dimensions, mounting interfaces and finish requirements for drawing review.

questions.question: What types of products do you manufacture?
answer: We manufacture custom sheet metal parts, enclosures, housings, cabinets, panels and non-standard metal products based on customer drawings or design requirements.
Typical applications include intercom systems, ordering kiosks, electrical equipment, communication systems, security equipment, lockers and precision equipment housings.

questions.question: Do you have a minimum order quantity?
answer: There is no fixed minimum order quantity.
We can support single-piece prototypes, small-batch orders and production quantities. Pricing will depend on the material, manufacturing process, setup requirements and order quantity.

questions.question: What drawing formats do you accept?
answer: We can review common engineering drawing and 3D file formats, including:
Please include dimensions, material, thickness, tolerance, surface finish and quantity whenever possible.

questions.question: Can you manufacture from a sample?
answer: Sample-based evaluation may be possible, depending on the product.
However, drawings or dimensional information are strongly recommended to improve quotation accuracy and reduce the risk of misunderstanding.

questions.question: What materials can you work with?
answer: Material grade and thickness should be specified in the drawing or enquiry. Alternative materials may be reviewed case by case.

questions.question: What manufacturing processes are available?
answer: The final manufacturing route will be selected according to the product design, material, tolerance and order quantity.

questions.question: What tolerance can you achieve?
answer: Depending on the material, part geometry and manufacturing process, dimensional tolerance may reach approximately **±0.2 mm**.
Not every dimension can be controlled to the same tolerance. Critical dimensions and inspection requirements should be clearly identified on the drawing for engineering review.

questions.question: Can you produce prototypes?
answer: Yes. We can support prototypes and trial production before mass production.
Prototype lead time is commonly around one week, depending on material availability, product complexity, finishing requirements and engineering confirmation.

questions.question: What is the typical production lead time?
answer: Lead time depends on product complexity, quantity, material availability and surface treatment.
Simple orders may be completed in approximately 8 working days, while larger production orders commonly require around one month, including sample approval where applicable.
The confirmed lead time will be stated in the quotation.

questions.question: What surface finishes are available?
answer: Colour references, surface standards and appearance requirements should be provided before production.

questions.question: Can you manufacture outdoor or weather-resistant products?
answer: We can manufacture products with outdoor anti-rust and water-resistance requirements through material selection, structural design, welding, sealing and surface treatment.
However, an IP rating or other certified protection level should only be claimed after appropriate testing.
Third-party testing may be arranged on a project basis, subject to the customer's requirements, budget and testing standard.

questions.question: Are you ISO certified?
answer: Our manufacturing operation follows an ISO 9001 quality management system.
Relevant certification information may be provided during supplier qualification or project discussion.

questions.question: How do you control product quality?
answer: Quality control may include incoming material checking, dimensional inspection, in-process inspection, appearance checking and final inspection before shipment.
Inspection requirements, critical dimensions and acceptance criteria should be confirmed before production.

questions.question: Can you help improve my design for manufacturing?
answer: Yes. Our engineering team can review drawings for manufacturability and may suggest adjustments relating to bending, hole positions, welding access, material use, tolerances, assembly and production efficiency.
Any design changes will be discussed with the customer before production.

questions.question: Can you arrange international shipping?
answer: Yes. Depending on the shipment size and destination, delivery may be arranged by courier, air freight or sea freight.
Customers may also nominate their own freight forwarder or arrange factory collection.
Freight, customs duties, taxes and import clearance responsibilities will be confirmed separately.

questions.question: What information is required for a quotation?
answer: For a more accurate quotation, please provide:
Incomplete information may result in a preliminary quotation that is subject to engineering confirmation.

questions.question: How quickly can I receive a quotation?
answer: Quotation time depends on the complexity and completeness of the enquiry.
Straightforward parts may be reviewed quickly, while assemblies, tight-tolerance products or projects requiring material and process evaluation may require additional engineering review.
Providing complete drawings and requirements will help shorten the quotation process.

custom-metal-enclosures-cabinets.title: Custom Metal Enclosures & Cabinets
custom-metal-enclosures-cabinets.seoTitle: Custom Metal Enclosures & Cabinets Manufacturing | Well Da Metal Factory Limited
custom-metal-enclosures-cabinets.description: Drawing-based fabrication of metal enclosures, equipment cabinets, doors and mounting panels in steel, stainless steel and aluminium. Send drawings for review.
custom-metal-enclosures-cabinets.intro: Well Da manufactures custom sheet metal enclosures and cabinets to customer drawings. The metalwork can include cabinet bodies, doors, removable panels and mounting openings for equipment and electronic hardware.
custom-metal-enclosures-cabinets.imageAlt: Existing Well Da sheet metal boxes with formed sides, openings and painted surfaces
custom-metal-enclosures-cabinets.imageCaption: Existing enclosure metalwork from the Well Da product photographs.

sections.title: Enclosures built around your equipment
sections.text: Typical uses include equipment cabinets, communication hardware housings and metal boxes for control equipment. Door positions, cable openings, mounting holes and panel interfaces follow the confirmed drawing. The scope is the fabricated metalwork; electrical wiring and complete electrical control panels are not included in this service description.

sections.title: Materials and fabrication
sections.text: Available sheet materials include mild steel, stainless steel, electrolytic steel sheet and aluminium. Cutting or punching creates profiles and openings; bending forms the body and doors; welding joins suitable structures. Grinding, powder coating, stainless-steel brushing, polishing and silk screening are selected to suit the agreed material and finish.

sections.title: From drawing review to repeat orders
sections.text: Send dimensioned drawings and, where available, a 3D model. We review material, thickness, interfaces, critical dimensions, finishing and assembly requirements before agreeing the manufacturing scope. Prototype and small-batch work can be used to confirm fit before repeat production. Revisions and acceptance requirements should be confirmed for each order.

custom-metal-enclosures-cabinets.rfq: Include the enclosure dimensions, material and thickness, door and mounting details, finish, quantity and delivery destination. Upload your PDF, DXF, DWG or STEP files through the quotation form.

equipment-housings-machine-covers.title: Equipment Housings & Machine Covers
equipment-housings-machine-covers.seoTitle: Custom Equipment Housings & Machine Covers | Well Da Metal Factory Limited
equipment-housings-machine-covers.description: Custom sheet metal equipment housings, removable machine covers and maintenance panels fabricated to drawings, with cutting, bending, welding and finishing.
equipment-housings-machine-covers.intro: Well Da fabricates non-standard metal housings and covers to match the customer’s equipment design. Work can include outer housings, machine covers, removable lids and maintenance access panels.
equipment-housings-machine-covers.imageAlt: Existing press brake used to bend sheet metal
equipment-housings-machine-covers.imageCaption: Bending equipment shown in the existing manufacturing gallery; this is a process photograph.

sections.title: Access, fit and installation
sections.text: Equipment builders can specify cover profiles, service openings, attachment points and removable sections to suit their own machine layout. Provide adjoining-part dimensions and clearances so the cover can be reviewed as part of the equipment assembly. A fabricated cover does not establish machine safety certification or an IP protection rating.

sections.title: Materials and manufacturing route
sections.text: Mild steel, stainless steel, electrolytic steel sheet and aluminium can be evaluated against the drawing and operating environment. Laser cutting or punching forms cut-outs and fixing holes. Bending shapes the covers; welding is used where the design calls for joined parts. Powder coating or suitable stainless-steel finishing can be specified for the agreed surface requirements.

sections.title: Prototype through production
sections.text: Begin with drawings showing the equipment interfaces and the required material and finish. A prototype or small batch can support checks of fit, access and installation before repeat production. Any changes to hole positions, panel clearances or assembly details are confirmed against the drawing revision before manufacture.

equipment-housings-machine-covers.rfq: Upload cover drawings and any relevant assembly views. Include overall dimensions, fixing details, material, thickness, finish, quantities and the intended operating environment. State any testing requirements for separate review.

sheet-metal-panels-chassis.title: Custom Sheet Metal Panels & Chassis
sheet-metal-panels-chassis.seoTitle: Custom Sheet Metal Panels & Chassis Fabrication | Well Da Metal Factory Limited
sheet-metal-panels-chassis.description: Metal front panels, instrument panels, mounting plates and chassis made to drawings with cut-outs, bending, welding, finishing and silk screening.
sheet-metal-panels-chassis.intro: Well Da produces custom front panels, instrument and equipment panels, mounting plates, chassis and metal enclosure frames from customer drawings. Hole patterns, bends and printed markings are manufactured to the agreed specification.
sheet-metal-panels-chassis.imageAlt: Existing flat metal panels with cut edges and hole patterns
sheet-metal-panels-chassis.imageCaption: Metal panels from the existing Well Da website image collection.

sections.title: Panels and supporting metalwork
sections.text: Applications include front faces for instruments, access-control equipment panels, internal mounting plates and chassis supporting equipment components. Provide cut-outs, connector positions, mounting interfaces and visible-surface requirements. Metal control panels here refer to fabricated panels, without electrical components or wiring.

sections.title: Materials, openings and markings
sections.text: Sheet materials include mild steel, stainless steel, electrolytic steel sheet and aluminium. Cutting and punching create profiles and apertures; bending forms flanges; welding joins chassis sections where required. Finishing and silk-screen printing can add the agreed surface appearance and legends. Confirm artwork, orientation and drawing revision before production.

sections.title: Review the interfaces before manufacture
sections.text: Submit dimensioned drawings with critical hole centres, mating dimensions and assembly information. We review material, thickness, finish, markings and inspection requirements. Prototype, small-batch and repeat orders are supported, with the production scope and any assembly work confirmed for the specific project.

sheet-metal-panels-chassis.rfq: Send the panel or chassis drawing, material and thickness, order quantity, finish and any silk-screen artwork. Identify critical dimensions, assembly requirements and the delivery destination in your RFQ.

homepage.title: Custom Sheet Metal Parts & Assemblies Made to Your Drawings
homepage.intro: Enclosures, cabinets, equipment housings, panels, chassis and brackets for OEMs and equipment builders. Prototype, small-batch and repeat production.
homepage.processes: Laser cutting, punching, bending, welding, finishing, silk screening and suitable assembly work are selected to match the confirmed drawing and manufacturing requirements.

manufacturingGuide.title: From Prototype to Production
manufacturingGuide.text: Start with a dimensioned drawing and material, thickness, quantity and finish requirements. Drawing review defines cut-outs and profiles before forming and joining; finishing and silk screening follow the agreed surface and artwork requirements. Suitable hardware insertion and assembly are confirmed for each project. Prototype or small-batch checks can confirm fit and appearance before repeat production. Critical dimensions and inspection requirements are agreed for the specific part; process locations and production arrangements are confirmed per project.
